summary: Iteration 5 (Playtest & Economy Tracking panel in Town Hall) verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). All 22+ frontend checks passed. Panel with testID 'analytics-panel' is present and COLLAPSED by default (analytics-body absent until toggle). Tapping 'analytics-toggle' expands the body and renders all six sections (Current Tracking Session, First-Event Times, Economy Totals, Contract Activity, Production Activity, Milestones). Unreached first-events correctly display 'Not reached' (e.g. testID 'analytics-first-scrap' == 'Not reached' on fresh boot). Session duration is live — observed 'Session duration' testID 'analytics-duration' advance 6s -> 12s over ~5s. Copy JSON (testID 'analytics-copy-json') triggers game-toast 'JSON copied' and Copy CSV (testID 'analytics-copy-csv') triggers 'CSV copied' (clipboard works in Chromium web preview via expo-clipboard). Reset Tracking (testID 'analytics-reset-tracking') opens 'analytics-confirm-modal': Cancel dismisses cleanly; Confirm ('analytics-confirm-go') shows 'Tracking session reset' toast and CRITICALLY does NOT change game progress — verified HUD coins ('2000'), level ('LVL 2'), and Town Hall restoration ('0/100') were identical before and after reset. After a Collect Scrap on the Town tab, First Scrap flipped from 'Not reached' to '22s', confirming counter re-tracking works, and after Reset Tracking it went back to 'Not reached'. Reset Game (testID 'analytics-reset-game') opens the same confirm modal; Cancel path preserved state (coins remained 2000). Regression: dev-grant-coins-button, dev-grant-level-button, dev-grant-materials-button, dev-reset-upgrades-button, dev-force-emergency-button all functional (Grant Coins moved 0 -> 1000/2000, Grant Level moved LVL 1 -> LVL 2). Contracts tab renders contract cards. No red-screen or crashes. No deprecated Expo packages introduced (expo-clipboard is current). Pre-existing warnings 'shadow* deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' persist (unrelated to this feature).

critical_code_review_comments: AnalyticsPanel.tsx: clean, small (~205 lines). Uses expo-clipboard correctly with try/catch fallback toast ('Copy failed — clipboard unavailable') — matches spec.

GameContext.resetTracking (line 538-550): Correctly (a) resets analyticsAccumRef synchronously so idle/active timers restart cleanly, (b) rebuilds state.analytics via createAnalytics(now, prev.level, prev.restoration_points), and (c) does NOT touch resources/upgrades/contracts/level. Verified in UI. Good separation of concerns.

AnalyticsPanel Modal uses a single shared modal for BOTH reset-tracking and reset-game distinguished by `confirm` state. The confirm-go button dispatches based on `confirm === 'game'`. Works, but a small race: if `confirm` becomes null between button press animation and dispatch it would no-op. In practice fine — kept for review.

Milestones section iterates config.restoration_milestones with `key={m.points}` — good. Consider useMemo on `analyticsSummary(state, config)` to avoid recomputing on every re-render while the panel is expanded and state ticks each second.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (22/22 checks across two automation runs; every required testID from the review request verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playtest & Economy Tracking panel is fully wired and validated. When testing future analytics-touching features: (1) Always start from a fresh boot to see 'Not reached' on first-events; (2) The panel is collapsed by default — must click 'analytics-toggle' first; (3) The Reset Tracking confirm modal and Reset Game confirm modal share the same testID 'analytics-confirm-modal' — distinguish by the confirm title text ('Reset tracking session?' vs 'Start a fresh test?'); (4) Copy JSON/CSV toasts DO fire successfully in headless Chromium via expo-clipboard, contrary to the spec's cautious 'may be blocked' note.
